results.name: handheld console
results.description:
Made with heavy inspiration from the Nintendo 3DS, This console from the late 2000s is completely **copyright-free**  and can be used anywhere **without any credits**.

* The original color is teal, though it's possible to change it with some nodes in Blender.
* The textures are **4k**, which makes it possible to have smaller details that still look great. 
* The model was made in *Blender*, while the textures were made in *Adobe Substance Painter*.

results.name: Nintendo Switch 3D Scan in Full Color
results.description:
3D scan of Nintendo Switch video game console. 
3D scanned with the Artec Space Spider and processed in Artec Studio. 
This scan was completed without 3D scan spray, talc, or any special preparation, coating, etc. The only accessories used was a turntable. 

Total time to scan: 5 minutes
Total time to process to watertight mesh: 30 minutes
Total time to optimize the mesh, smooth, etc.: about 2 hours

results.name: Nintendo Switch 2 Realistic 3D Model
results.description:
This is a highly detailed and realistic 3D model of the new Nintendo Switch 2 console.

Features include:

* High-quality polygonal modeling optimized for web visualization.

* Physically based rendering (PBR) textures for realistic surface detail.

* Includes all major console elements such as screen, buttons, ports, and Joy-Con controllers.

* Perfect for presentations, animations, CGI projects, and product visualization.

Created using Blender and exported for Sketchfab compatibility.

For inquiries or commissions, please contact NAIT Studio.

results.name: Dreamcast Console
results.description:
Sega Dreamcast is a home video game console released by Sega. It was the first in the sixth generation of video game consoles, preceding Sony’s PlayStation 2, Nintendo’s GameCube, and Microsoft’s Xbox. The Dreamcast was Sega’s final home console, marking the end of the company’s eighteen years in the console market.
